title: Generative AI Feasibility & Business Case
short_desc: A business case on whether — and how — a global design department should start using generative AI, weighing costs, benefits and risks.
blueprint_desc: Written as my bachelor's thesis together with Michael Wulff for The LEGO Group's Graphic Design Team. We looked at how generative AI could support the designers, compared different ways of introducing it, and weighed the time it could save against the cost and effort. The report ended with clear recommendations on legal risks, practical challenges in the organisation and the financial impact — and the team's leadership wrote us a letter of recommendation.
tech_notes: Evaluated the practical feasibility of adopting Generative AI pipelines for a corporate graphic design division. Built and analyzed multi-tier implementation scenarios mapping out creative efficiency gains against technical overhead. Delivered definitive, data-driven recommendations that outlined the legal risk frameworks, practical organizational hurdles, and bottom-line financial implications of automated tooling workflows.
